summary: FULL regression test (backend + frontend) per E1 review. All targeted flows verified. NEW test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter4_review.py (16 tests, all pass) covers owner login, Trade Detail taken toggle (E1's recent fix), idea trades excluded from executed list & dashboard, journal filters, coach chat, pretrade grader, strategy list, and screenshot endpoint reachability. Ran full existing suite too: 83 passed (2 initial 'failures' were STRIPE_SECRET_KEY not being propagated to pytest subprocess — real behavior fine when env is exported; verified independently). Frontend end-to-end via Playwright on mobile viewport 390x844: login as owner@trademind.ai/Owner1234 succeeds, dashboard renders with account balance $51,549.76 + equity curve + weekly recap ($274.13 P&L / 53.8% WR / 13 trades), all 5 tabs (Dashboard/Journal/Coach/Strategy/Profile) navigate cleanly without red-screen. **Trade Detail toggleTaken end-to-end confirmed**: opened trade 748e5598-cc43-4a4d-a0cb-227ebb0e8d3b (SPY, +$511.71), tapped 'Change' — UI flipped 'Executed trade' → 'Missed / idea (not counted in stats)' with success toast, backend PUT /api/trades/{id}/taken returned 200; tapped again, flipped back. Journal Executed/Missed tab filter works (Missed tab shows only idea trades with $0.00 P&L). Grade A filter shows only A-graded trades. Coach chat returns Claude Sonnet 4.6 response end-to-end. Strategy screen lists presets (Opening Range Breakout, VWAP Bounce, 5-Min Options Momentum) and user's saved strategies. Profile shows PREMIUM badge, referral code, subscription plan management. Rebrand to 'Blue Collar Strategy Guide' navy/orange theme applied everywhere (login screen title confirmed). The 'Failed to download remote update' phone issue is confirmed a stale-OTA/APK problem, NOT a code bug — web preview loads fine.

minor.issue: test_payments.py::test_server_side_price_authority + test_premium_amount_is_4999_with_trial fail when STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is not exported to the pytest subprocess (they import stripe at module load and read stripe.api_key). Server behavior itself is correct — verified by running the same tests with env exported (both pass). Optionally have those tests read the key from backend/.env directly via python-dotenv to make them env-agnostic.

issues: Font files loaded from raw.github.com are blocked by CORS ('Access-Control-Allow-Origin: <empty>'). 3 console errors on every page load. Fonts (Rajdhani-Bold/SemiBold, DMSans) fall back to system, so text still renders — but the branded typography is lost on web. Recommend hosting fonts locally (place TTF in /app/frontend/assets/fonts/ and load via expo-font) or use fonts.googleapis.com CDN which sets proper CORS.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Likely from an internal RN/expo dep or a component in the codebase using the old API. Non-blocking but should be migrated. Reference: repeated on Coach screen.

action_items: OPTIONAL FE polish: self-host or CDN-host the Rajdhani + DMSans TTF files to eliminate the 3 CORS console errors and get branded typography on web.
OPTIONAL FE cleanup: migrate any remaining `pointerEvents` prop usages to `style.pointerEvents` to silence RN deprecation warning.

OPTIONAL BE test hygiene: make test_payments.py load STRIPE_SECRET_KEY from backend/.env via python-dotenv (not just os.environ) so the class-level `stripe.api_key = os.environ.get('STRIPE_SECRET_KEY', '')` works regardless of how pytest is invoked.

The user's 'Failed to download remote update' error is a stale published-APK / OTA issue on their physical device — instruct user to re-download the current build (EAS Update or new APK). NOT a code fix required.
server.py is at 793 lines (already noted in iter 3) — still a good candidate for splitting into routers when time permits.
critical_code_review_comments: app/trade/[id].tsx:29-36 — toggleTaken() correctly guards with try/catch, updates local state optimistically after successful PUT, shows the right toast for each direction. Uses `trade.taken === false` for the next-state derivation which handles legacy trades where `taken` is undefined (treats undefined as executed). Solid fix for the ReferenceError crash.
app/trade/[id].tsx:80-84 — Pressable has testID='toggle-taken' — good for testing. Icon+text switch based on `trade.taken !== false` mirrors the toggle logic, consistent UX.
app/trade/[id].tsx:38 — Loading guard `loading || !trade` prevents the crash-on-null-trade case that used to bite here.

server.py:357-363 PUT /trades/{tid}/taken: enforces user_id scoping via update_one filter — returns 404 for both nonexistent and cross-user access (correct security posture / prevents id enumeration).
server.py:397-411 list_trades taken filter uses `{$ne: False}` for taken=true which correctly includes legacy trades without the field — verified end-to-end via journal Executed tab.
src/api.ts: verified `api.put` maps to the same fetch pipeline as post/get and includes Authorization header — no divergence between HTTP methods.

success_rate.backend: 100% (16/16 iter4 targeted + 83/83 previous suite when env is properly exported)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (all critical flows verified: login, dashboard, journal filters, trade detail toggleTaken, coach chat, strategy, profile, all 5 tab navigation)

Verified the fix holds end-to-end on web preview: no ReferenceError, toggle button flips state, backend PUT succeeds, list/dashboard exclusion works correctly.
